name: A Reading of Us
overview: Kawe and Henrique have always been great friends, but when Henrique breaks up with his boyfriend, Kawe devises a crazy plan to keep him from suffering. The situation gets complicated when Kawe falls in love with Henrique, leading him to question whether love is more important than friendship.
